scope: Native source-bridge integration with scripted owner approval and synthetic publications, not a frontier analysis, human onboarding or comparative business-value trial.

card.policy: Investigate pending or hypothesis-only findings. Notify the configured Growth owner for a published observed activation decline of at least five percentage points. A signed fraction of -0.08 means an eight-percentage-point decline; an onboarding hypothesis is not an established cause.

runs.finding: observed decline of -0.08; separate unconfirmed onboarding hypothesis

retained_preflights.reason: Generated source manifest was 0644; CLI setup requires 0600. Test fixture and example instructions corrected before inference.

retained_preflights.scope: Fresh native setup, scripted card approval and inspection of all three publication revisions.

artifact_review.disposition: GO for the narrow native integration claim
artifact_review.kind: Independent internal agent audit, not external peer review
artifact_review.checked: Source/provider/result/stored receipt agreement, reconstructed revision hashes, saved card equality, closure, preflight/build fingerprints and proxy usage.
artifact_review.replay_limit: The passing native test checks the replay response; that response was not separately retained. Stored originals and the absence of a fourth provider attempt were independently checked.
artifact_review.trace_label_note: Trace events retain the generic episode label preflight; actual live HTTP responses and usage identify the three provider requests.

limitations: Three supplied revisions are integration controls, not independent business trials or a general accuracy estimate.
No frontier analyst produced these synthetic findings; no raw BI discovery, real human setup, schedule or external delivery ran.
The scripted policy supplies the change interpretation. Measurement windows and populations were not independently established.
Publication identity, byte hash and authorization do not verify claim truth or analyst identity. Probabilities are not a calibration result.
No baseline, customer SSO, cost advantage, human-message quality or deployed hosted publication proof is claimed.
Atomic replacement/concurrent publication and an expired freshness SLA were not exercised in this live check; capture times were preserved, not independently verified as true.
Full private artifacts and the matching native build are reproduction prerequisites. This closed cohort must not be rerun.
